details: Global oil prices, particularly Brent crude, rose on May 18, 2026, fueled by fresh Middle East tensions and stalled peace talks between the US and Iran. This has heightened inflation fears and increased expectations of central bank interest rate hikes. US President Donald Trump issued a strong warning to Iran, further escalating concerns. The Strait of Hormuz remains a key point of contention for potential supply disruptions, driving crude prices higher.
title: Oil Prices Rise, Bonds Wobble Amid US-Iran Tensions

details: The United States and China have reached a consensus on agricultural trade and other priorities, establishing the U.S.-China Board of Trade and the U.S.-China Board of Investment following a high-stakes summit. China has committed to significant purchases of US agricultural products, including beef and poultry, and Boeing aircraft. This aims to manage bilateral trade and address non-tariff barriers.
title: US and China Establish New Trade & Investment Boards

details: G7 Finance Ministers and Central Bank Governors met in Paris on May 18-19, 2026, for a ministerial meeting under France's G7 Presidency. Key discussions focused on global economic instability, inflation risks, energy prices, trade tensions, and the economic impact of the ongoing Iran conflict. The meeting serves as a crucial step in preparing for economic and financial decisions to be submitted to G7 Leaders in June.
sourceName: French Ministry for the Economy and Finance
title: G7 Finance Ministers Convene to Discuss Global Economy, Iran Conflict
